verdict.rationale: A hardware security-key vendor could plausibly ship a documented SDK or management API, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only standards compatibility (W3C WebAuthn over HID), GUI management tools (SK Manager, iePassManager, OTP Tool), and buildable OpenSK firmware, which are standards, host-platform features, or developer building blocks rather than a documented public API for driving the product. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
